correctness.rationale: Actual Lutz 12-vertex facet-list blob af1e826ee89752ca8ba15d23a44a7821ddd1f701 was independently decoded from all 54 tetrahedra. Independent mod-3 boundary construction produces f=(12,66,108,54), ranks rank ∂1=11 and rank ∂2=54 and dim H^1=1. The displayed 28-edge cocycle satisfies every triangular cocycle equation and is not a coboundary (augmented rank 12). An independent finite complete enumeration over all 3^11=177147 vertex potentials p(1)=0 gives exact minimal weight 28 with precisely 18 distinct supports, including independently reproduced full weight histogram. Closing the two published facet-preserving S3 generators gives exactly six automorphisms and support-orbit sizes 3,3,6,6. This finite exhaustive enumeration PROVES the stated finite claim; it does not claim a lens-space invariant across triangulations.

evidence: Lens-space manifold and triangulation classification theorems classify facets/number of tetrahedra but provide no all-cocycle coset weight distribution.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General lens-space triangulation minimality and H1=Z3 do not bound the 66-edge cochain Hamming weight sharply; the new 177147-coset enumeration adds the exact invariant.
